title: New Nonprofit Banking Team Providing Specialized Financial Solutions to NJ Organizations & Schools
summary: A nonprofit banking team has been launched by Kearny Bank to serve nonprofit organizations as well as charter and independent schools throughout New Jersey. The team emphasizes specialized banking solutions and financial expertise.
body_markdown:
**FAIRFIELD, NJ (Oct. 13, 2026) –** A nonprofit banking team has been launched by Kearny Bank to serve nonprofit organizations as well as charter and independent schools throughout New Jersey. The team emphasizes specialized banking solutions and financial expertise.


Led by **Mount Olive, NJ** resident Cori Macri, Senior Vice President / Nonprofit and Independent Education Banking, the team brings five decades of combined experience providing relationship-based banking services, and helping nonprofit and independent school clients to plan, manage, and grow their financial resources. Solutions being offered include deposit accounts, working capital lines of credit, term loans, and commercial real estate financing.


“Nonprofit organizations play an essential role in the communities we serve, and their financial needs are quite different from those of other businesses,” says Anthony V. Bilotta, Executive Vice President / Chief Banking Officer. “Our nonprofit banking team combines Kearny Bank’s broad range of financial capabilities with specialized expertise and relationship management, providing client organizations a dedicated resource for effectively managing their finances and advancing their missions.”


Macri, who was most recently with JPMorgan Chase Bank, holds a bachelor’s degree in political science from Dickinson College and an MBA from Centenary University. Her commitment to the nonprofit sector also includes volunteer support for several YMCA organizations, Habitat for Humanity, and financial literacy education.


**About Kearny Bank**


Combining the finest traditions of community banking with the industry’s latest, most effective financial products and services, Kearny Bank provides business and personal clients with the tools for success. Established back in 1884, and now operating from corporate offices in Fairfield, NJ, Kearny Bank’s footprint covers most of New Jersey, along with Brooklyn and Staten Island. Additional information is available at[kearnybank.com](https://www.kearnybank.com/) or by visiting Kearny Bank’s social media channels:[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kearnybank) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kearny_bank/) ,[X](https://twitter.com/KearnyBank) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/1319584) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwieXSwL9OscxNRUhzWwQyQ) .
